document.title: Working with agents
document.p: sxml is built by an orchestrator session that delegates packets to subagents. This directory holds the prompts those agents get, so the work can be picked up by any later session and is never stuck in one.

item.p: BRIEF.md: the common brief every agent follows.
PACKET.md: how to work a packet from docs/tasks/.
QUEUE.md: what runs now, what comes next, and the leftovers that no packet owns yet. The orchestrator keeps it current.

section.title: How a session continues the work

item.p: Pick the next packets from QUEUE.md and the task files. Packets that own disjoint files may run at the same time.

Give each agent a prompt that says: read docs/agents/BRIEF.md and docs/agents/PACKET.md, the packet's number and task file, the decisions to read first, the goal and its done-when, and which other packets run at the same time and the files they own.
When an agent reports, record what it left over in QUEUE.md, and commit that change on its own.

section.p: The prompt of each packet is its entry in docs/tasks/phase-N.md plus the lines given in step 3; anything an agent decides goes into docs/DECISIONS.md and its commit messages, so the history explains itself.
